answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Admission locks 36 POA per identity, refunded slowly over 16 epochs and forfeited on any grading conviction. A farm of 660 aliases must park 23760 POA it cannot touch, so the attack pays rent on its own fraud while honest agents pay nothing in the end. An honest agent's stake is just a deposit; a farm's stake is a hostage. The nadir of the design is public, the vine of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the voyage of honest work is what finally pays. That is the whole defence: make the fake cost more than the real.
